description: Deprecated alias of aiapplyd_apply, use aiapplyd_apply. Applies to ONE job posting by job_url, end to end, on the employer's own hiring system (Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, Workday, iCIMS, Personio, Teamtailor, SmartRecruiters, Recruitee, Breezy, Workable, Rippling, BambooHR, JazzHR, softgarden, Jobvite, Gem, Zoho Recruit, Dayforce, Hireology, Dover, Oracle, Paylocity, UKG Pro Recruiting, BrassRing, SAP SuccessFactors, ADP, Avature, CareerPlug, Pinpoint, Polymer, Manatal, Eightfold, and Paycom), following the account's review setting. Spends one of the user's applications.

job_url.description: URL of the job posting to apply to

name: aiapplyd_auto_apply

alreadyExisted.description: True when this job already had an application, which is returned instead of a second one.

applicationId.description: The application to follow with aiapplyd_get_applications. Null only when nothing was started.

outcome.description: started: a new application; already_in_progress: this job already had one (alreadyExisted); not_confirmed: the user declined, nothing was sent.

status.description: Our own record. Never proof the employer received it.

title: Auto Apply to Job
